headline: Elon Musk tries to explain what’s going on with Ukraine and Starlink
summary: Elon Musk accuses Zelenskyy of lying about Starshield disruptions. Musk claims Ukraine is misusing Starlink for military purposes. Comments made amid ongoing conflict at DealBook Summit.

headline: The nation’s largest school districts consider ditching Google Search
summary: Major US school districts may drop Google Search. Google will disable Search for schools opting out of AI features. Schools must accept Gemini AI or lose Search access next year.

headline: Democrats skip a vote on adding Brendan Carr’s adviser to the FCC
summary: Democrats boycotted a Senate vote for an FCC nominee. The vote was for President Trump's appointee, Danielle Thumann Severs. Republicans proceeded with the confirmation hearing despite the boycott.

headline: Absolute Batman can save DC Studios
summary: DC Studios faces uncertainty after Skydance acquired Warner Bros. Discovery. Co-heads James Gunn and Peter Safran are out. The article speculates on Batman's role in saving the cinematic universe.

headline: GTA 6 Launch Causes Massive Spike in Traffic for Internet Provider Xfinity
summary: GTA 6's launch significantly boosted internet traffic for Xfinity. The traffic spike was observed on Xbox consoles. The surge coincided with the game's New Zealand release.

headline: The Mac Mini Sized Acemagic Ryzen 7 Micro PC With 24GB RAM and 512GB SSD Is on Sale for Black Friday
summary: Acemagic Ryzen 7 Micro PC is on Black Friday sale. Features 24GB RAM and a 512GB SSD. This Mac Mini-sized PC offers a powerful, compact deal.

headline: GTA 6 Doesn't Let Players Pick Up Prostitutes, but Rockstar Has a Logical Reason for It
summary: GTA 6 will not feature prostitute pick-up mechanics. Rockstar Games provided a 'logical reason' for this design choice. This marks a shift from previous GTA titles' controversial elements.

headline: The LEGO Poké Ball Set Gets Its First Discount Ahead of Amazon's Black Friday Sale
summary: The LEGO Poké Ball set receives its first discount. The sale is available ahead of Amazon's Black Friday event. Fans can now grab the popular set at a reduced price.

headline: Inside the old gas pipeline where Ukraine is fighting an underground war with Russia
summary: Ukrainian forces are fighting an underground war in old gas pipelines. This tactic helps them avoid Russian drone detection. The BBC documented the hidden conflict with Ukrainian troops.

headline: McDonald's sex abuse: 'They were waiting for the younger girls to turn 18'
summary: A legal case against McDonald's over alleged sex abuse can proceed. A former worker accused the company of mistreating young employees. Concerns raised about waiting for staff to turn 18.

headline: Claude-maker Anthropic poised for more than $1.4tn stock market debut
summary: AI firm Anthropic is set for a massive stock market debut. The Claude-maker could achieve a $1.4 trillion valuation. Anthropic has become a major player in artificial intelligence in five years.

headline: Can Anthropic's record-breaking IPO stop the AI bubble bursting?
summary: Anthropic's anticipated IPO could be record-breaking. It's expected to rank among the top 10 most valuable US companies. Questions arise whether this IPO can prevent an AI bubble burst.
